text.p: - A new law which introduces a fee for crossing the Russian border, is likely to ruin the country's export industries.
- Nikolai Yegorov, the former head of the presidential administration, is facing a tough fight to stay in power in the southern region of Krasnodar.
- The Chechen leaders are using the oil issue to raise the price of their loyalty to Russia.
- The State Duma lower house of Russian parliament is trying to accelerate passing the 1997 budget but it is unlikely that the budget will be approved before the end of the year.
- The arrest of a US agent allegedly working for Russia indirectly proves that the Russian counter-intelligence service is still very efficient despite all recent reorganisations.
- Russia's state secrets are guarded safely, says the chief of Federal Security Service Nikolai Kovalyov.
- The Communist Party of Russia plenum revealed a number of ideological disagreements.
- The state is powerless against terrorism in Chechnya.
